summary: The diff implements REQ-1 by updating MonthlyVolumeSummary.tsx to display 'Total Plank Time' and 'Total Squash Time' as separate metrics in minutes, and by adding an aggregateMonthlyTotals function in habitModel.ts that returns totalReps, totalPlankMinutes, and totalSquashMinutes. Press-ups and Squats retain their 'Total Reps' counters. REQ-2 is satisfied as YearlyProgressChartSection.tsx is not modified. All acceptance criteria appear to be met: minutes-only format with 'min' unit label, visually distinct layout, zero-fallback via the aggregation function, and month-tab-driven updates through the selectedMonth prop.
